summary: Enhance your expertise with our Industrial Pollution Control Technologies Training Course. Learn effective strategies to combat pollution and ensure compliance.
lede: Industrial pollution control covers practical methods for environmental, operations, maintenance, and treatment professionals managing emissions, wastewater, waste, and noise. The training covers selecting and operating control technologies, setting performance measures, and maintaining systems such as filters, scrubbers, and treatment processes. Participants also learn to plan monitoring, interpret results, document findings, and investigate incidents using root-cause analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals actively engaged in planning, operating, monitoring, procuring, regulating, or auditing pollution control technologies.
audience: Utilities and energy operations staff (boilers, generators
Water and wastewater treatment operators and technicians
modules: Industrial Pollution Control as a Performance System
Air Pollution Control Technologies I: Particulates and Dust
Air Pollution Control Technologies II: Gases, VOCs, and Odors
Wastewater and Effluent Treatment Technologies I: Primary and Secondary Treatment
Wastewater and Effluent Treatment Technologies II: Advanced and Specialized Treatment
Solid and Hazardous Waste Management Technologies
Noise, Vibration, and Community Impact Controls
Operations, Maintenance, and Reliability of Control Systems
Incident Prevention, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Actions
Audit Readiness, Permitting, and Environmental Documentation
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of environmental regulations and industrial processes. Experience in EHS management, plant operations, or environmental compliance is recommended.
